Class SyncedMui2UI

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2.Mui2UI
com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2.SyncedMui2UI
All Implemented Interfaces:
HostUI
public class SyncedMui2UI extends Mui2UI
Mui2UI for a server-synced screen: reuses its wrapper and ticks the sync manager. Lifetime is owned by MuiSyncedSession; use its release handshake rather than unrelated main-window close paths.

    • SyncedMui2UI

      public SyncedMui2UI(com.cleanroommc.modularui.screen.ModularScreen screen)
      Creates a host for a synchronized screen after the framework has constructed it. The caller must supply a genuinely server-bound screen; the wrapper check alone is not a synchronization handshake.
      Parameters:
      screen - framework screen with its server-created container/wrapper
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no usable wrapper exists after base initialization

  • Method Details

    • isServerBound

      public static boolean isServerBound(com.cleanroommc.modularui.screen.ModularScreen screen)
      Detects a non-client-only container with a synchronization manager and wrapper. Unconstructed screens or failed container lookups are treated as not server-bound.
      Parameters:
      screen - framework screen to inspect
      Returns:
      true when it needs a synchronized host/session instead of a local adapter

    • update

      public void update()
      Updates the UI, then ticks the container if its synchronization manager is live. UI update failures propagate; container update failures are logged.

      Ticks the ModularUI context, then calls the screen's update hook.

      Advances the visible screen's logic on a client tick. HostUI's default implementation does nothing.

      Ticking is independent of the window's frame-rate limit. First layout happens during rendering, so this callback can run before onResize. Initialize any state needed here before opening the window, or wait until layout has supplied the required dimensions.

    • dispose

      public void dispose()
      Runs the current disposal hook after panel cleanup, even if cleanup throws. Before replacing an obsolete adapter, the session changes its hook to a no-op.

      Closes an open ModularUI panel manager, then disposes it once closed. An already-disposed manager is ignored.

      Releases resources owned by this adapter when its hosted entry is removed. Do not dispose borrowed global Minecraft or framework resources. The hosted entry prevents duplicate disposal calls for that entry.

      Disposal does not enter this adapter's scope. Do not assume that temporary Minecraft state supplied by the scope is active during cleanup.

      Specified by:
      dispose in interface HostUI
